scope: Combine the complete non-C_A Bordignon remainder, Abel/count-transfer costs, and the explicit exact-population density on one normalized scale. Derive a precise admissible C_A formula and one conservative sufficient condition. Do not invent or assert a source upper for C_A, close Hypothesis 1(2), Proposition 9.2, SIV-08, or compute X_cert.

dyadic_supremum.term_3_endpoint: L+log 2 because it increases with u
dyadic_supremum.other_source_term_endpoints: L because their relative terms decrease with u on the certified domain

conditional_budget.B0: sum of the 13 normalized non-C_A component uppers
conditional_budget.reason_for_power_minus_6: transport margin A-n=10 minus the printed +4 power in term 4

proof_cutoff.uniformity: termwise calculus shows the normalized bounds decrease with L inside each r-bin and with integer r from the stated corner

conditional_source_requirement.warning: This is a condition to be tested by H1c-1b.4d, not a value supplied by Bordignon 2021.

numerical_corner_diagnostic.role: regression diagnostic only; exact rational inequalities and calculus carry the proof

next_gate.description: Rederive the growing-A Theorem 3.4 and zero-density constant package and compare the resulting C_A growth with the exact admissible envelope from H1c-1b.4c.
next_gate.stop_condition: If the source-derived C_A grows faster than the admissible envelope, do not promote P9.2; quantify the mismatch and reconsider the transport margin or analytic source.
